# Scenario: successful app compose pull/up writes container_deployed with
# project + sorted desired service keys (containers) and added (all new).
# Empty removed/started are omitted from JSON. Unchanged/running stacks on a
# later cycle do not emit again (README Events).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: container deployed baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: first deploy emits container_deployed with added ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'container deployed project=e2e-cdepok containers=api,web added=api,web removed=\(none\) started=\(none\)'
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepok-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepok-api
exists $HOME/.events
grep 'container_deployed' $HOME/.events
grep '"project":"e2e-cdepok"' $HOME/.events
grep '"containers":"api,web"' $HOME/.events
grep '"added":"api,web"' $HOME/.events
! grep '"removed"' $HOME/.events
! grep '"started"' $HOME/.events

exec sh -c 'cp "$HOME/.events" "$WORK/events.after-first"'

# --- Cycle 2: healthy idempotent run must not append another deploy event ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepok-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepok-api

exec sh -c 'cmp -s "$HOME/.events" "$WORK/events.after-first"'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-cdepok
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9963
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-cdepok/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
  api:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=API"]

-- .env --
